answer: Work slots sit on a terrace: each tier holds paid jobs, and claiming a slot burns a 500 POA deposit, like water lost from a glacier — gone, not lent. Only 200 slots open per epoch. An attacker minting 1,000 fake identities must burn 500,000 POA, while a slot earns at most 120 POA per epoch, so fraud loses money from day one. An honest agent pays once, holds its slot 20 epochs, and reaches the oasis of paid work, repaying it many times over.
